payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $50 Visa Reward Card for each individual referred (Referred Person) to MBT Bank who registers for the offer using the Referrer's shared personal referral link, opens a new eligible account and completes all offer requirements.
steps: Complete the referral registration form on the MBT Bank refer page to get your personal referral link
Share your link with friends/family (or provide their contact info for an email invite)
Friend registers via your link BEFORE opening a new eligible MBT Bank checking account (GoPremium, GoPlus, GoSimple, GoSmart)
Within 60 days of opening, friend completes: direct deposits totaling $1,000+, enrolls in eStatements, activates a new debit card
You earn a $50 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral, delivered by mail in 4-6 weeks
catches: Cap: $500 in referral rewards per calendar year (10 x $50); rewards may not be rolled over
Friend must be new: no MBT checking account now or in the last 12 months (same for anyone added to the account)
Friend must register via your link BEFORE opening the account
Qualifying direct deposits only: payroll, pension, Social Security, government benefits — teller/ATM/mobile deposits, wires, bank transfers, and Zelle/Venmo do NOT qualify
Reward is a Visa Reward Card (not cash), good for six months, subject to card terms
Cards delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements met; reward card amount may be reported to the IRS
Only one referrer per friend (first referral link used); employees not eligible; friend requirements may indirectly disclose that the friend opened an account
biggest_catch: Your friend must push $1,000+ of real direct deposits (no Zelle/Venmo) into the account within 60 days — and your reward is a Visa card, not cash.
eligibility: MBT Bank customers with a personal referral link; referred friends must be new-to-MBT checking (none in last 12 months)
timing: Requirements within 60 days of account opening; reward cards delivered in 4-6 weeks
